metadata.title: Atrio — Book your barber, follow the queue live
metadata.description: Atrio shows salons near you, live wait times and open slots. Book or join the queue, and show up when it's your turn.

hero.heading: Show up when it's your turn.
hero.subheading: Atrio shows salons near you, live wait times and open slots. Book your barber or join the queue, then follow your place in line until it's your turn.
hero.screenLabel: Preview of the Queue screen: your position moves up and the estimated wait drops as the clients ahead of you are served.

problem.heading: A haircut shouldn't cost you the afternoon.

unknownWait.title: You find out the wait when you get there.
unknownWait.body: There's no way to know how many people are ahead before you leave. So you sit on the bench and wait.

barberTaken.title: Your barber is already booked.
barberTaken.body: You came for someone in particular, and they have three clients ahead of you.

salonMemory.title: Salons run the queue from memory.
salonMemory.body: Who came first, who booked, who left: it all depends on the team remembering.

howItWorks.heading: Three steps from your couch to the chair.
howItWorks.intro: It all happens in the app: find a salon, pick your slot, then follow the queue until it's your turn.

discover.title: Find a salon near you
discover.body: Search by neighbourhood or service. Each salon shows its hours, services, barbers and client reviews.
discover.screenLabel: Preview of the Discover screen: search, filters and a list of salons with their rating and opening status.

book.title: Book, or join the queue
book.body: Pick a service, your barber or whoever is free first, then a time. No appointment? Switch to Walk-in and take your place in line.
book.screenLabel: Preview of the booking screen: reservation or walk-in, barber, day and time slot.

follow.title: Follow your turn live
follow.body: Your position and estimated wait update in real time. Leave at the right moment and tap "I'm here" when you arrive.
follow.screenLabel: Preview of the Queue screen: your position, the estimated wait and the clients being served before you.

salonsTeaser.heading: Your whole shop day on one screen.
salonsTeaser.body: Atrio gives salon owners a dashboard to run the queue, bookings and team, right from their phone.

queue.title: Live queue
queue.body: Move the queue forward, skip a no-show or add someone who walked in without the app.

bookings.title: Today's bookings
bookings.body: See at a glance who's confirmed, who's on the way and who's still pending.

team.title: Team and services
team.body: Manage your barbers, their availability, your prices and how long each service takes.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.body: Track bookings, revenue, average rating and your most requested services.

salonsTeaser.dashboardLabel: Preview of the salon dashboard: today's figures, upcoming bookings and team availability.
salonsTeaser.queueLabel: Preview of the salon-side queue: client in the chair, next clients and controls to advance the queue.

features.heading: Also in the app
features.intro: The things that make each visit easier, before and after the cut.

favorites.title: Favourite salons
favorites.body: Keep your go-to places close so you can book faster.

reviews.title: Reviews with photos
reviews.body: Read reviews before you choose, and leave your own after your visit.

loyalty.title: Loyalty points
loyalty.body: Earn points on every visit, trade them for rewards and refer your friends.

messages.title: Messages
messages.body: Message the salon directly with a question or a special request.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Confirmations, reminders and queue updates arrive on your phone.

language.title: French or English
language.body: The app speaks your language, in light or dark mode.

faq.heading: Your questions
faq.intro: What to know before your first booking.

liveQueue.question: How does the live queue work?
liveQueue.answer: When you join a salon's queue, Atrio shows your position and an estimated wait. Both update as the salon serves its clients. You can leave home at the right time, then let the salon know you've arrived with "I'm here".

chooseBarber.question: Can I choose my barber?
chooseBarber.answer: Yes. When booking, pick the barber you want, or choose "Any barber" to get the earliest slot.

walkIn.question: Do I have to book ahead?
walkIn.answer: No. You can book a specific slot, or choose Walk-in to join today's queue.

manageBooking.question: Where do I find my bookings?
manageBooking.answer: In the Bookings tab. You'll see your upcoming and past bookings, and can add one to your calendar or cancel it.

salonJoin.question: I own a salon. How do I sign it up?
salonJoin.answer: Download Atrio, create your account and choose "Salon owner". You then set up your salon, barbers and services right in the app.

languages.question: Is the app available in French?
languages.answer: Yes. Atrio is available in French and English. You can switch language in the settings.

download.heading: Your next cut, without the wait.
download.body: Download Atrio to find a salon, book your barber and follow the queue live.
download.notYet: Atrio is coming soon to iOS and Android.

salonsHero.metaDescription: Run your salon's queue, bookings, team and services with Atrio.
salonsHero.heading: Your queue, bookings and team, in one place.
salonsHero.subheading: Atrio helps salons and barbershops handle walk-ins and bookings from a phone. Your clients see the wait live and arrive at the right time.
salonsHero.screenLabel: Preview of the salon-side queue: client in the chair, next clients, Advance queue and Manual entry buttons.

salonsShowcase.heading: Built for the rhythm of a salon.

queue.title: Run the queue in real time
queue.body: See who's in the chair and who's waiting. One tap to move the queue on, skip a no-show or add someone who came without the app. Your clients follow their position live.
queue.points: Advance queue|Skip a client|Manual entry|Average wait

day.title: Your day at a glance
day.body: The dashboard brings together today's bookings, revenue, average wait and each barber's availability.

stats.title: See what's working
stats.body: Track bookings by week or month, your average rating, revenue, most requested services and your team leaderboard.
stats.points: Weekly and monthly view|Top service|Team leaderboard
stats.screenLabel: Preview of the Statistics screen: key figures, bookings per day and team leaderboard.

team.title: Barbers and services
team.body: Add your barbers, assign their services, set prices and durations.

profile.title: Salon profile
profile.body: Name, description, photo gallery, contact details and opening hours.

notes.title: Offline client notes
notes.body: Each client's preferences and habits, even without a connection. Everything syncs when you're back online.

export.title: Booking export
export.body: Export your bookings as a PDF or by email, for any date range.

salonsSteps.heading: Open your queue in a few minutes.
salonsSteps.intro: Sign-up happens entirely in the app.

download.title: Download Atrio
download.body: Create your account with your phone number.

role.title: Choose "Salon owner"
role.body: This unlocks the salon management space.

setup.title: Set up your salon
setup.body: Add photos, hours, barbers and services with their prices.

open.title: Open the queue
open.body: Clients find you, book and follow their turn live.

salonsFaq.heading: Salon questions
salonsFaq.intro: What owners ask us most often.

walkInsAndBookings.question: Can I handle both bookings and walk-ins?
walkInsAndBookings.answer: Yes. Clients can book a slot or join today's queue. You see both in the dashboard and in the queue.

severalBarbers.question: My salon has several barbers. How does that work?
severalBarbers.answer: Add each barber with the services they offer. Clients can pick a specific barber or whoever is free first, and you can follow each one's availability.

offline.question: What if the connection drops?
offline.answer: Client notes stay available and editable offline. Changes sync as soon as you're back online.

clientsNeedApp.question: Do all my clients need the app?
clientsNeedApp.answer: No. A client who walks in without the app can be added to the queue with Manual entry.

languages.question: Which languages does the salon space support?
languages.answer: French and English, like the rest of the app.

salonsDownload.heading: Ready to open your queue?
salonsDownload.body: Download Atrio, choose "Salon owner" and set up your salon.
